backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT platform managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minted tokens with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a deployment-fix feature to specific frontend files and components, with high confidence and a single test requirement.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and configuration for the NFT art portfolio app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light-art portfolio app, setting German language, metadata, and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, NFT, blog, admin, etc.) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Alert banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing an error message and a retry button that reloads the page.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for admins to create or update NFT collections, using React state and mutation hooks with German-language toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of all NFT collections with edit (via dialog) and delete (via alert dialog) actions, showing loading skeletons and empty state as needed.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and submission via create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and per-item edit/delete actions including a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, with hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: Small badge component that shows backend connectivity status (checking, online, or unreachable) based on a health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, title, description, mint date, token ID, and abbreviated owner principal, with an optional 'my NFT' highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), an actor error banner, a main content slot, and a footer with backend status and attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar that renders standard nav links and conditionally shows an Admin link only after the backend confirms admin status, with a retry button on timeout or error.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an individual NFT's image, title, collection name, price, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component that displays an NFT collection's image, title, and description, linking to its Getgems marketplace trade URL.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven predefined NFT collections (e.g., Lichtei, Wheel of Time) using NFTCollectionCard, each linking to Getgems.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal that shows an NFT's image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), and provides copy-to-clipboard fields and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helper functions to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, then saves it via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Static dataset of blog posts about light and eye health (wavelengths, blue light effects, red light therapy), typed as StaticBlogPost with bigint publication timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that exposes a boolean isActorReady flag and sets an actorError if the actor fails to initialize within a 20-second timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: React Query hook that pings the backend every 60 seconds using getAllCollections() to determine backend availability for a status indicator.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always returns null, as blog creation is disabled in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls actor.addCollection to create a new NFT collection and invalidates related queries on success, with admin authorization error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a new NFT via actor.addNFT, fetches the created NFT to return it with full metadata, and invalidates nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT collection by ID and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the actor and invalidates nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for the old artwork system, kept to avoid breaking components that still reference it.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: React Query hook that returns an empty array for blog posts, as the old blog backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
React Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, returning an empty array if the actor is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: React Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via the backend actor's `listAllNFTs` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor using `getAllNFTs`.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Stub React Query hook that always returns null, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Stub React Query hook that always returns an empty array, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub React Query hook that always returns null for a blog post, deferring to static posts since the blog backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, only running when the user is logged in and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's own issued NFTs via `listMyNFTs`, keyed by principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin permissions by calling `isCallerAdmin` on the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Hook that checks admin status via `checkIsAdmin` with a configurable timeout, exposing a detailed phase state and a retry function.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT item and issued-NFT caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates the current user profile cache on success.
Stub mutation hook for contact form submission that does nothing, as the contact form backend is currently unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always returns null, as artwork upload has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that uploads an image file to the backend actor as an `ExternalBlob`, with progress tracking, format validation, and auth error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a warm luminous color palette in both light and dark modes, plus custom scrollbar styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with a timeout, then renders tabbed UI for managing NFT collections and individual NFTs, with phase-based loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards with dates, and shows a 'New Post' button for admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Blog post creation page that renders a disabled form with an info alert indicating blog creation is unavailable because the system has migrated to NFTs.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post page that looks up a post by ID from static data or the backend, then renders its title, date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that shows a success state on submission, with an alert noting the form is still under construction.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page featuring a hero banner, an inspirational quote, NFT collections section, NFT explanation component, and a CTA link to the NFT gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching NFT and collection data by ID from URL params and displaying image, metadata, price, and on-chain explorer link with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Gallery page listing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/login UI using tabbed layout.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload page allowing authenticated users to create a new NFT by filling out a form with title, description, price, collection, and image file, then minting it on-chain with progress feedback.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID from either source, and format timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state metadata including version, existing features, and configuration for a deployment fix project. Records one existing feature focused on resolving compilation/syntax/configuration errors causing deployment failure.
